name: My Legacy
source:
This game will be about a single man, who works as a creator of erotic novels, and because of that work and his craziness he is lonely all the time. But he isn't all alone. He has his pals "Mr. D" and "the brain". All of them come to the conclusion that it would be the best idea ever to continue the guy's legacy by impregnating the females of his brother's family, when they came for a visit to him.

Can you help him accomplish his plans and how?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/saddoggames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
这部游戏讲述一名孤独的男子。他以创作色情小说为生，也因这份工作和自己的疯狂而始终孤身一人。不过，他并非完全没有伙伴。他和“D先生”以及“大脑”一起得出了一个绝妙的主意：当哥哥一家前来拜访时，让家中的女性怀上孩子，延续这个男人的血脉。

你能帮助他实现计划吗？又该如何实现？

（来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/saddoggames]Patreon[/url]）
